stem.en: A panchayat member has finished her five-year term. Most villagers think she did well, but the rule says the seat must be filled by a fresh election. Why is this rule useful even when a member has done well?

text.en: So that she must step down and rest for a term.
So that a different person always takes the seat and everyone gets a turn.
So that the people she answers to can judge her work.
So that the State Government can decide whether she should stay in her seat.

explanation.en: An elected member answers to the people who chose her. A fresh election lets them judge her work and either choose her again or choose someone else. She may well win again, because the rule does not force a change.

hints.en: Who did she promise to serve, and how can they judge her?
A fresh election can return the same person. Which options forget this?
